selection.source: RC2 VMR F# subtree, locally built; not an official RC2 SDK
selection.reason: RC2 and main have byte-identical production sources. Their full F# subtrees differ in build scripts, tests and documentation.

payload.bootstrap: Pinned RC2 sources compiled by SDK 11 RC1, then used to compile the Release product and new Core
payload.compiler_build_core: Fresh source Core, netstandard2.1, following repository project references
payload.deployed_core_reason: Match the Core variant selected for SDK tools by #20555
payload.runtime_qualification: The local RC2-source compiler runs on the exact .NET 11 RC1 runtime. It is a source-built compiler comparison, not a measurement of an official RC2 SDK/runtime bundle.

measurement.inputs: Unchanged first-campaign source, references, arguments and IDE graphs
measurement.runtime_environment: Remove inherited DOTNET_* and COMPlus_* variables, then set only host location and telemetry preference. Exact framework selection; no GC/JIT/DATAS overrides.
measurement.application_runtime_policy: SDK10-generated programs on .NET10.0.0; RC1 and local RC2-generated programs on .NET11 RC1, with normal application runtime defaults.
measurement.historical_data: First-campaign measurements, including fixed-runtime application controls, remain separate and unchanged.
